title: Description of incarceration rates trend chart
text:
Description of incarceration rates trend chart

 Line chart of the number of persons incarcerated in prison or jail per 100,000 population from 1980 to 2000. The incarceration rate rose from 139 per 100,000 in 1980 to 478 per 100,000 in 2000. The incarceration rate increased every year during the period. It rose faster in 1980 to 1982, followed by a slower increase until 1988. After a large increase from 1988 to 1989, the pace of increase slowed. After 1996 the incarceration rate increased about 4% annually. From 1998 to 1999, the incarceration rate increased by 3%. From 1999 to 2000, there was a 1.3% increase.
